stage_0_hash.rule: Compute SHA256 of recovered bytes before CSV parsing. Exact mismatch => STOP_BYTE_IDENTITY_FAIL and no content parsing.

stage_1_header_only.rule: Read only header after hash pass. If any normalized column contains a forbidden term, classify FORBIDDEN_COLUMN_PRESENT_FAIL_CLOSED and do not read data rows.
stage_1_header_only.missing_direct_n2_rule: If any direct N2 required column is absent, classify HEADER_MAPPING_REQUIRED_STOP_BEFORE_VALUE_READ, record header only, and stop before data rows. A separate mapping preregistration may be created from header names only before any value access.

stage_2_values_only_if_direct_columns_ex.row_count_rule: Report exact data-row count and compare to expected 14255; mismatch is DATASET_SHAPE_MISMATCH but does not authorize alternate files.
stage_2_values_only_if_direct_columns_ex.race_count_rule: Report unique race_id count and compare to expected 2000.
stage_2_values_only_if_direct_columns_ex.required_value_missingness: Report exact missing count/rate for every direct N2 column; zero missing is required for STRICT_DIRECT_VALUE_COMPLETENESS.
stage_2_values_only_if_direct_columns_ex.race_shape_rule: Report rider-count distribution by race_id. Frozen N2 synthetic validation is STANDARD_FI_FII_7; any non-7 race produces MIXED_EVENT_FORMAT_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_ROUTING rather than silent coercion or deletion.
stage_2_values_only_if_direct_columns_ex.line_structure_rule: For each race/line group, car_no must be unique, line positions contiguous from 0, and line_size must equal group membership count. Report failures exactly; do not repair values.
stage_2_values_only_if_direct_columns_ex.distribution_summary: For score and wind_speed_mps report min, q05, median, q95, max; for bank/class/style/line_size/race_size report counts. This is support diagnostics only, not training or calibration.

interpretation_rules: Compatibility does not mean predictive validity, calibration, edge, profitability, or promotion.
No row may be excluded because it is inconvenient for compatibility diagnostics; failures are reported, not tuned away.
No alias/mapping may be invented after viewing data values. Header-only mapping may be separately preregistered before value access if required.
No real PRE data may be used to fit N2 coefficients, shrinkage, thresholds or feature selection under this gate.
stop_rule: Stop immediately on byte identity failure, forbidden column detection, or missing direct N2 columns. In the missing-column case only header names may be used to preregister a deterministic mapping before any value access.
